shortDesc: Multi-agent IPL 2026 mini auction simulation — 10 LLM-powered franchise agents bid on 370+ players using DeepSeek reasoning via a LangGraph pipeline.
fullDesc:
A full simulation of the IPL 2026 mini auction where 10 LLM-powered franchise agents replace human decision-makers. Each agent operates with real individual purse constraints (2.75 Cr to 64.3 Cr) and competes for remaining squad slots across four player specialisations to assemble 25-player squads.

Built on a LangGraph state machine with 5 nodes:
• Data Loader — loads post-retention team rosters from official IPL CSV data
• Host — controls simulation routing between nodes
• Host Assistant — cycles through player sets, routes back to Host
• Bidder Pool — 10 franchise agents bid in Greedy Sequential Order using Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning over player valuation, squad constraints, rival budgets, and market dynamics
• Trade Master — handles price progression; after 3 consecutive passes, finalises the trade and generates a 10-dimension reasoning summary to inform subsequent bids

Run on AWS EC2 (~3 hours per full simulation) using deepseek-ai/deepseek-v3.1 via the NVIDIA API, with a Streamlit dashboard for visualisation.
highlights: 10 LLM franchise agents bid on 370+ real IPL 2026 mini auction players
68 of 77 real-world signings replicated — 36.4% player overlap with ground truth
Capped players retain 80.5% of real price; uncapped only 12.7% (data sparsity issue)
Chain-of-Thought reasoning over 5 decision axes: valuation, utility, squad fit, rivals, purse trajectory
Exposes LLM hallucination and long-context degradation in multi-round auction settings
